ModMetaData.name: Yayo's Animation Tick Overflow Fix
ModMetaData.author: ifchen0
ModMetaData.description:
Unofficial fix for Yayo's Animation (Continued).
Symptom: in long-running saves, job animations break for many pawns. A burning pawn rolling on the ground pops far to the bottom-right and slides back with a fixed facing, instead of rolling out and back while turning. Most work, social and idle animations simply stop playing; mining, chopping and eating wobble out of step.
Cause: the animation frame is computed as (game ticks + pawn ID * 20) % length. Once the game tick count and pawn IDs get large enough, the sum overflows into a negative number, the remainder becomes negative, and the animation is stuck extrapolating its first segment.
Fix: the remainder in the standing and laying animation code is made non-negative. Nothing changes for saves where the overflow does not happen.
Safe to add to or remove from an existing save.
